item.title: (USA) Staff, Machine Learning Engineer - Walmart
item.description:
**Position Summary...** -----------------------
**What you'll do...** ---------------------
Position Summary...
As a Staff Machine Learning Engineer, you will architect and lead the development of scalable, production-grade ML systems that address complex business challenges. This role requires designing robust ML architectures, driving innovation in advanced modeling techniques, and overseeing the full ML lifecycle from data sourcing to deployment and monitoring. You will provide technical leadership, mentor engineering and data science teams, and collaborate cross-functionally to ensure alignment with platform strategies. Your expertise will advance Walmart’s ML capabilities, delivering impactful solutions that enhance operational efficiency, customer and associate experiences
**About the team**
At FinTech, our team develops and scales AI and ML driven solutions for Finance enabling faster, smarter, more consistent and precise month end close process. We apply machine learning, statistical techniques, forecasting, computer vision and optimization techniques to solve complex financial challenges including anomalous sales posting, cash loss management, financial reconciliation and proactive insights through agentic tools. Our solutions span predictive AI, agentic AI, and perception AI through computer vision. The team combines deep technical expertise with strong business partnership to build robust, scalable systems that improve financial accuracy, operational efficiency, and decision-making across the organization.
What you'll do...
* Architect and guide scalable, production-grade machine learning systems integrated into customer/associate facing products. * Lead end-to-end ML lifecycle execution, including data sourcing, feature engineering, model training, deployment, and monitoring. * Partner with cross-functional teams to align ML solutions with broader platform strategies, ensuring effective integration, scalability, and long-term sustainability. * Design and build scalable, reliable infrastructure for deploying and serving computer vision models, leveraging containerization, GPU orchestration, and inference optimization frameworks such as NVIDIA TensorRT. * Drive end-to-end performance benchmarking, capacity planning, and cost optimization of ML workloads. Partner with MLOps and infrastructure teams to establish best practices for GPU utilization, model serving, monitoring, and production reliability. * Champion advanced MLOps practices such as CI/CD pipelines, model versioning, drift detection, and performance telemetry. * Mentor engineers, influence architectural decisions, and promote engineering excellence across teams. Evaluate emerging infrastructure patterns, model paradigms and platform capabilities into a forward-looking roadmap.
What you'll bring:
* Extensive experience architecting scalable, production-grade machine learning systems and platforms. * Hands-on experience designing, developing, and deploying computer vision solutions, including object detection, multi-object tracking, action recognition, and video analytics, using deep learning architectures and frameworks such as PyTorch, OpenCV, and YOLO. * Proven experience building and optimizing end-to-end computer vision pipelines, including video preprocessing, model training, fine-tuning, GPU-accelerated inference, and deployment, with a focus on accuracy, latency, throughput, and scalability. * Deep knowledge of neural networks, deep learning, natural language processing, reinforcement learning, and time series analysis. * Hands-on experience building systems that support advanced agentic architectures, such as memory, trace, eval, orchestration and routing layers for complex model systems. * Proven ability to lead technical strategy, mentor engineers, and influence cross-functional collaboration. * Excellent critical thinking and technical writing capabilities to communicate complex concepts clearly.

item.title: Machine Learning Engineer, Implicit Signals - OpenAI
item.description:
Applied AI Engineering - San Francisco
### **About the Team**
Our team builds classification and evaluation systems that give post-training and research teams fast, reliable feedback on model behavior. We combine machine learning and production engineering to make these capabilities accurate, efficient, and useful at scale, helping researchers assess changes and improve models and products.
We work closely with research teams to develop useful measurements and make them practical to run. Our work spans classifier development, rigorous evaluation, and efficient production inference, with ownership from initial experimentation through deployment and continued improvement.
### **About the Role**
We’re looking for a machine learning engineer to develop new classification and evaluation capabilities and bring them into production. You’ll help turn open-ended questions about model behavior into well-defined ML problems, build methods that address them, and establish how reliably those methods work.
This role combines traditional machine learning, model evaluation, and real-time engineering. You’ll own classifiers throughout their lifecycle, including supervised fine-tuning, distillation, evaluation, deployment, and production inference. You’ll work closely with researchers to identify valuable problems and with software engineers to make promising approaches useful at scale.
### **In this role, you will:**
* Build, deploy, and operate production classification and evaluation systems that provide useful feedback to post-training and research teams. * Optimize production inference, including model serving, batching, caching, throughput, latency, compute utilization, and cost. * Train and optimize classifiers using supervised fine-tuning and distillation, validating quality and efficiency before deployment. * Own the reliability and observability of deployed classifiersance over time. * Design rigorous evaluations that assess accuracy, calibration, generalization, and potential measurement bias while guiding production tradeoffs. * Partner with software engineers to integrate models into reliable execution systems and support safe rollouts. * Build reusable engineering tools that make classifier training, evaluation, deployment, and iteration faster and more repeatable. * Work with post-training researchers and data scientists to translate their needs into modeling objectives, evaluation criteria, and production requirements.
### **Your background might look something like**
* Experience taking ML projects from problem formulation and experimentation through production deployment. * Strong foundations in supervised learning, statistics, and experimental design. * Practical experience evaluating models, investigating systematic errors, and working with imperfect labels. * Strong software engineering skills and the ability to build maintainable production ML systems. * Experience reasoning about inference performance and the tradeoffs between quality, latency, and compute cost. * The ability to combine careful scientific judgment with a practical approach to shipping and operating software. * Comfort working closely with researchers and engineers on open-ended problems. * Fluency in using AI agents to move quickly across multiple workstreams in a fast-paced environment. * Experience with model distillation, representation learning, calibration, or efficient inference is a plus.
**About OpenAI**
OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core the full spectrum of humanity.

item.title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer - Risk and Trust - Uber
item.description:
**About the Role**
We are looking for an experienced Staff Machine Learning Engineer to join Uber's Risk and Trust engineering organization. Our team plays a critical role in protecting users and maintaining the integrity of Uber's global platform through advanced fraud prevention, identity verification, and account security solutions.
As fraud threats continue to evolve, including increasingly sophisticated AI-driven attacks, we leverage cutting-edge machine learning techniques to build scalable, intelligent risk detection and prevention systems. In this role, you will lead the development of high-impact ML solutions, tackle complex technical challenges, and collaborate closely with cross-functional partners to deliver measurable business impact while maintaining seamless user experiences.
**What You'll Do**
* Collaborate with product, data science, and engineering partners to proactively identify high-impact business opportunities, formulate complex ML problems, and help shape the team's technical roadmap. * Apply deep expertise in machine learning, optimization, and statistics to design and develop innovative, scalable, and robust ML solutions that drive measurable business impact. * Provide technical leadership on complex ML initiatives, drive engineering best practices, and mentor other MLEs to elevate the team's technical capabilities. * Own the end-to-end ML development lifecycle, including data preparation, feature engineering, model development, system design, implementation, A/B testing, deployment, and production monitoring. Partner with cross-functional teams to productionize ML solutions at scale.
**Basic Qualifications**
* 8+ years of industry experience developing machine learning models, including classical ML and deep learning, and deploying ML solutions to production. * Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related technical field. * Strong problem-solving skills and a solid foundation in machine learning algorithms, statistics, and optimization. * Demonstrated experience applying ML techniques to solve complex, large-scale real-world problems. * Proficiency in Python and experience with modern ML frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX. * Experience building large-scale data pipelines and working with distributed data processing frameworks such as Spark and SQL-based systems.
**Preferred Qualifications**
* PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related technical field. * Hands-on experience with advanced ML techniques, such as deep learning, representation learning, sequence modeling, multi-task learning, reinforcement learning or large language models. * Experience developing ML solutions for fraud detection, anomaly detection, or other adversarial environments. * Demonstrated ability to independently drive complex ML projects from problem formulation through production deployment. Experience working with large-scale, real-time ML systems and making data-driven decisions in production environments.

item.title: Machine Learning Engineer - Nox Metals
item.description:
**Machine Learning Engineer | Nox Metals | Los Angeles, CA**
**About Nox Metals.** American factories deserve a supply chain that moves as fast as they do. Nox Metals is building it, along with the tools that run it. We’re a technology company with operations in Metro Detroit and Los Angeles, supplying aluminum plate, bar, and rounds to aerospace and defense manufacturers. We use software and automation to supply metal to American factories faster than the industry thought possible.
**The role.** We’re hiring a Machine Learning Engineer to build production systems that make quoting, material selection, planning, and factory decisions faster and more accurate. You will work with messy operational data, test ideas against real outcomes, and put the useful ones into production.
This is applied ML. A model matters only when it improves a decision, survives real operating conditions, and earns the trust of the people using it.
**You will:**
* Identify high-value opportunities for machine learning and optimization * Build datasets, features, models, evaluation systems, and production pipelines * Establish strong baselines before adding complexity * Deploy models into customer and internal workflows with software engineers * Monitor model quality, drift, latency, and business impact * Design safeguards and clear fallbacks for uncertain predictions * Work with operators and domain experts to understand constraints and failure modes * Improve data quality and make model behavior explainable * Document experiments and communicate tradeoffs clearly
**You are:**
* Strong in applied machine learning, statistics, and software engineering * Comfortable working in Python and SQL * Rigorous about evaluation and skeptical of impressive-looking demos without evidence * Able to turn an operational problem into a measurable learning problem * Comfortable deploying and maintaining models, not just training them * Curious about factories, materials, and supply chains * Clear, practical, and willing to change course when the data disagrees
**Nice to have:**
* Experience with operations research, geometric optimization, forecasting, or pricing * Experience with industrial, logistics, or marketplace data * Experience building human-in-the-loop decision systems * Experience applying modern AI models responsibly in production
**Benefits:**
* Equity in Nox Metals * Company-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance
This role is full time, in person in Los Angeles.
**Nox Metals is an equal opportunity employer. We hire based on skill, attitude, and fit for the work, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, height, weight, marital status, or any other protected status under federal, state, or local law.**

item.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, New Verticals Agentic Foundations - DoorDash
item.description:
**About the Team** ------------------
Agentic Foundations, part of New Verticals ML, builds the core AI/ML intelligence that powers high-quality, scalable agents at DoorDash, and proves it through flagship agent experiences such as the Ask grocery assistant. We operate as a closed loop: new models, evals, and representations make our agents better, and real-world agent usage surfaces the gaps that drive our next foundations work.
**About the Role** ------------------
We're looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join Agentic Foundations with a primary focus on Vertical Agent Development. You will own the continuous improvement of our flagship agents, starting with the Ask Assistant, using an eval-driven loop to make them faster, more cost-efficient, and more reliable for millions of customers. You will also help us bring this approach to new agentic experiences for Merchants and Dashers, turning promising ideas into production-ready agents.
This is a chance to work at the intersection of LLMs, agents, post-training, and evals on problems that ship. You will partner closely with engineers working on agentic memory, agent-compatible product representations, and post-training of small language models (SLMs), so that what we learn from production agents feeds directly back into our foundations, and what we build there makes our agents better.
You will report into the engineering lead on our New Verticals AI/ML team. We expect this role to be hybrid with some time in-office and some time remote.
**You're excited about this opportunity because you will…** -----------------------------------------------------------
* **Raise the quality of our Consumer agents:** build and refine our eval harness-optimization loop to pinpoint failure modes, then iterate on prompts, tools, skills, and context, and measure the impact on real customer tasks. * **Find the best balance of quality, latency, and cost:** run rigorous experiments, including fine-tuning open-weights models and deploying small language models (SLMs) where they can replace or augment larger LLMs. * **Launch new agents:** take agentic opportunities for Merchants and Dashers from early exploration to production. * **Turn foundations into product impact:** work with teammates on agentic memory, agent-compatible product representations, and post-training SLMs for steerable generative recommendation, and bring those capabilities into production agents. * **Shape the roadmap:** partner with engineering, product, and business leaders to define an ML-driven strategy for our fast-growing grocery and retail delivery business.
**We're excited about you because you have…** ---------------------------------------------
* 3+ years of industry ML experience, including hands-on work building and shipping LLM-based agents (tool use, context management, prompting, guardrails) and improving them with evals and data * Experience with post-training or fine-tuning of open-weights models (e.g., SFT, preference optimization, or RL), ideally including small language models, and sound judgment on quality, latency, and cost trade-offs * Strong foundation in NLP and machine learning, with proficiency in Python and frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow * M.S. or PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, Math, or another quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience, plus a collaborative, growth-minded approach and a drive for measurable impact
**About DoorDash** ------------------
At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.
DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.
**Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion** ---------------------------------------------
We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Technology
Machine Learning Engineer Graduate (Conversational AI) - 2027 Start
**Location :** San Jose
**Employment Type :** Regular
**Job Code :** A211317
Responsibilities
**Team Introduction:** We build the next-generation unified Agent system for TikTok's global e-Commerce customer service — running in 30+ languages across one of the largest e-Commerce surfaces on the internet. Our north star is a self-evolving Agent: post-training, harness, memory / context engineering, tools, and evaluation form one closed loop, and every served conversation becomes the next iteration's training / eval / retrieval / skill-induction signal. This loop is already running in production — cases are mined, root-caused, turned into constrained candidates, replayed against frozen regression sets, and shipped behind guardrails. Two things make this team different from most "LLM application" work: - We build the agent runtime itself — Codex / Claude-Code-class — not prompts on top of a vendor API. - Evaluation and experimentation are first-class systems, not an afterthought. A self-improving loop optimizes whatever signal you give it, so the hardest and most valuable engineering here is making the judgment trustworthy — not just making the model change. By combining generative recommendation, large recommendation models, multimodal representation learning, and cross-domain value modeling, the team works on some of the most important algorithmic problems in live commerce. Our goal is to improve user experience, optimize ecosystem efficiency, and drive sustainable business growth for TikTok Shop across global markets. We are looking for talented individuals to join our team. As a graduate, you will get opportunities to pursue bold ideas, tackle complex challenges, and unlock limitless growth. Successful candidates must be able to commit to an onboarding date by the end of the year. Please state your availability and graduation date clearly in your resume. Candidates can apply to a maximum of two positions and will be considered for jobs in the order you apply. The application limit is applicable to our Company and its affiliates' jobs globally. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis - we encourage you to apply early. Responsibilities: - Agent runtime (harness / agent loop). Orchestrate skills, tools, and context; implement loop control & intervention, progressive disclosure, and behavior-level guardrails. Build the production safety layer — pre-flight budgets and timeout truncation, serve-time gates, shadow / swap-in answer delivery, and safe fallback paths. - Context & memory for long multi-turn agents. Agentic memory (structured note-taking), context compaction / summarization, context editing / observation masking, and just-in-time (retrieve-then-load) retrieval. Treat context as an evolving, itemized playbook — with structured diffs and a deterministic curator — rather than an ever-growing prompt. - Post-training & the data flywheel. SFT / DPO / RL to internalize rules into weights (so the prompt gets shorter, not longer), plus distillation to smaller serving models. Turn served conversations into training / eval / retrieval signals. - Tools, Skills, and MCP. Tools-as-APIs, connectors, skill / tool search for large inventories, and skill-library governance — description conflicts, trigger evals, cross-skill mis-fire matrices, and on-demand loading instead of dumping every definition into context. - Evaluation you can bet a launch on. LLM-as-judge with human-agreement calibration; statistical rigor — paired comparison, confidence intervals, repeated sampling, pass^k; held-out and time-rolling eval splits with overfitting alarms; cascaded scoring and cross-family judge panels to make evaluation affordable at scale. - The self-evolving loop. Case mining → automatic root-cause → constrained candidate generation → replay verification against frozen regression sets → canary → flywheel. Build the plumbing that makes it auditable: candidate registry with exact runtime read-back, change lineage, and an archive of rejected candidates you can sample from next round. - Online experimentation & causal readout. Shadow / canary / A-B, non-inferiority gates, traffic-split health, metric definitions that survive scrutiny, and off-policy counterfactual evaluation where live A/B isn't possible.
Qualifications
**Minimum Qualification(s):** - Individuals who are completing or have recently completed a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics or a related discipline - Strong Python plus one of C++ / Go / Rust / Java - Solid ML / DL / NLP fundamentals, with genuine hands-on experience with LLMs or agents (coursework, research, internship, competition, open-source, or a serious side project) - Basic statistical literacy — you can compute a confidence interval, explain what a p-value does and doesn't mean, and tell the difference between "the number went up" and "the system got better" - Able to read a paper or an engineering blog and turn it into working code Preferred Qualification(s) - Have built the runtime, not just called an API — even at research / hobby / competition scale: your own agent loop / harness, a memory / context-management system, a RAG or tool-use agent, or a fine-tuned / post-trained model - Hands-on experience in any one of the following — depth in one is enough, breadth welcome: - Post-training: SFT / DPO / RLHF / RLAIF / RLVR, reward modeling, reward hacking and how to defend against it - Agent systems: harness, context engineering, MCP / Skills, sub-agents, tool search - Evaluation & experimentation: LLM-as-judge and judge calibration, pass^k, regression suites, A/B and non-inferiority testing, off-policy evaluation - Self-improving / evolutionary systems: evolutionary program search, candidate archives and parent sampling, automatic prompt / context optimization, multi-objective (Pareto) selection and credit assignment - Inference & serving: vLLM / TensorRT-LLM, MoE, KV / prompt caching, and the cost engineering that comes with it - Multilingual NLP - Publications (for PhD), strong competition results (ACM-ICPC / Kaggle / ML competitions), or notable open-source contributions - Taste for the honest number. We'd rather hire someone who says "this result isn't significant yet" than someone who ships a green dashboard. If you've ever killed your own experiment because the evidence didn't hold up, tell us about it. - e-Commerce or multilingual experience is a plus, not required
